item.title: SCV 101: Naomi Young, President of the Santa Clarita Artists Association
item.description: On this episode of SCV 101, host Bill Miranda talks to Naomi Young to learn about how she became a painter at almost 50 years old and the mediums that she loves to work with, including oils, pastels, watercolors, mixed media, mosaics, and sculpturing. Naomi also tells us about her experience being the President of the Santa Clarita Artists Association and what it means to her personally, as well as the work she is doing to push the arts in the city
